instrument.model: ERB excitation distance between rendered waveforms

params.name: box_halfwidth_B
params.why: the truncation the fidelity gate exists to measure; M1 reads monotonicity across this sweep and B = 2 is also the RIVAL apparatus that must fail E1

params.name: witness_phase_cycles
params.why: the ONE genuinely free choice in the construction. The exact resynthesis has no phase freedom -- the FM identity gives all-cosine partials with signed amplitudes and cos is even, so the fold adds rather than flips. Freedom appears only where the witness pair is MOVED, and beat salience is phase-sensitive, so this is TESTED and not DECLARED

params.name: erb_grid
params.why: taken unchanged from brocot_marker_erb_gate so the distances here are commensurable with the ERB cells already banked

params.name: fidelity_ratio
params.why: the bar is a RATIO against the contrast the apparatus must carry, not an absolute distance I would be inventing; 0.10 says the resynthesis error must be an order of magnitude below the difference the stimulus isolates

params.name: cents
params.why: the FM twin this arc has used throughout, and the reference whose witness beat rate the additive twin is MATCHED to

params.name: duration_s
params.why: 3 s resolves 0.33 Hz, below the slowest witness beat in scope

phase_sweep.name: additive twin contrast by witness phase

amendment1.why: E2 was measured on a static ERB metric whose 57 Hz kernel cannot represent the 2-5 Hz manipulation; R1 passing (phase changed nothing to six figures) is the proof, since beat salience is phase-sensitive

ratios whose contrast fails to clear 10x.name: ratios whose contrast fails to clear 10x the instrument noise floor
ratios whose contrast fails to clear 10x.why: a count over the 8 ratios; the floor is a distance the same signal has from itself over a shifted window, so 0 is attainable

median resynthesis error as a fraction o.name: median resynthesis error as a fraction of the contrast
median resynthesis error as a fraction o.rival: a deliberately truncated resynthesis at B = 2
median resynthesis error as a fraction o.why: a ratio of ERB distances; 0 is attainable (an exact resynthesis) and a badly truncated one exceeds 1, so 5 is a generous ceiling

median selectivity: FM contrast over add.name: median selectivity: FM contrast over additive contrast
median selectivity: FM contrast over add.why: a ratio of ERB distances at MATCHED beat rate; 0 is attainable if the additive twin somehow moved more, and the ceiling is bounded only by the instrument's dynamic range

ratios whose truncation error is not mon.name: ratios whose truncation error is not monotone in B
ratios whose truncation error is not mon.why: a count over the 8 ratios across the 5-point B sweep

ratios whose E2 verdict changes across t.name: ratios whose E2 verdict changes across the phase sweep
ratios whose E2 verdict changes across t.why: a count over the 8 ratios across 4 phases

amendment: E1 stands as sealed: median resynthesis error 0.013 of the contrast against a 0.10 bar, with the B=2 rival failing the same bar at 3.30, so the arm discriminates. E2's sealed 30.03 is NOT readable as selectivity -- the static ERB kernel is ~57 Hz wide at the witness frequencies and the manipulation moves each partial by 1-3 Hz, so the metric cannot see its own object; R1 passing (phase changed nothing to six figures, when beat salience is phase-sensitive) is the proof rather than a reassurance. The correct readout is modulation-domain and it passes WITH BOTH CONTROLS: FM twin shows the beat 8/8, additive exact does not 8/8, additive twin carries it 7/8 at 37-88 dB. The exception is 5/7, whose witness pair sits at amplitude ~2e-4 and cannot beat audibly on its own -- and whose FM twin scores 25.9 dB against 42-117 dB elsewhere, i.e. its apparent cue was mostly collateral. SCOPE: the apparatus is usable at the 7 ratios whose witness pair clears audibility, and 5/7 must be excluded by name rather than averaged in.
